content.scenario: Rahul, a consumer, had his documents seized by the authorities during an investigation into a complaint he filed against a company. After 25 days, Rahul has not received his documents back.
content.outcome: The person seizing the documents must return them to Rahul within 20 days of seizure, after taking copies or extracts, as per CPA2019-CH3-S22-3. Since this was not done, Rahul can approach the authorities to return his documents.
